_note: Tier-1 sweep batch 008, June-July 2023, finishing the 2023 end: P7viEh9luCE, 2MOBOMGnCdE, wUNztkdwhXE, RlS3QooVBxg. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord brought back to him in prayer a word first given in the summer of 2022 about a massive volcano erupting.
mentions.quote: he told me about in 2022 was summer of 2022
mentions.falsify_match: A massive volcanic eruption follows the 2022 word.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the count as 510 days landing on 2 October, dating the dream to Yom Kippur and Rosh Hashanah of the previous year, and says the Lord told him he is extending the time frame and pushing it back to give more time for repentance.
mentions.quote: I'm extending the time frame and giving more time for repentance
mentions.condition_text: the Lord is said to have extended the deadline for repentance
mentions.falsify_match: A judgment event on or about 2 October 2023.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes without one, which he pre-explains as an extension.

mentions.claim_text: He says 2023 carried one of the first signs that all of this would fall like dominoes, that what is about to start is very serious, and that he sometimes misses the timing of what he sees.
mentions.quote: I missed timing sometimes whenever I'm seeing and I'm praying
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; a statement about his own accuracy.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; a statement about his own accuracy.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts an earlier word that never landed: a whole year went by through the pandemic with nothing, he apologised to his wife for having bought chickens on the strength of it, and concludes it was averted because they prayed.
mentions.quote: I guess that was averted we prayed
mentions.condition_text: he attributes the miss to prayer averting the event
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable; it is the account of a miss.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not scoreable; it is the account of a miss.

mentions.claim_text: In the 2014 visitation Jesus looked at him urgently and said to tell his people he is coming, and he says there are things from it he was told not to talk about.
What he was mocked for describing in 2014 had by 2021 become almost normal, with the government talking about it openly.
mentions.falsify_match: The subject he described in 2014 became a matter of open government discussion by 2021.

mentions.claim_text: He states his own position that he goes in the first round of the rapture before the tribulation, allows that others believe otherwise, and says if he is wrong they should seek him out for instructions.
mentions.quote: I'm going to go in the first round. I'm going with Jesus in the rapture
mentions.falsify_match: Not scoreable by ordinary evidence; a doctrinal position.

mentions.claim_text: In the 2014 tribulation vision he saw a Starbucks standing where at the time there was a barbecue house, and told his children a Starbucks would be there during the tribulation.
mentions.quote: there'll be a Starbucks there during the tribulation
mentions.falsify_match: A Starbucks is built on that site.
mentions.falsify_miss: The site never becomes a Starbucks.

mentions.claim_text: He reports that a brand new Starbucks was in fact built on that spot, and that buildings he saw in the tribulation vision which did not exist in 2014 were under construction by 2021.
mentions.quote: going to build a brand new Starbucks right there
mentions.falsify_match: The Starbucks and the other buildings were built as described.
